mapper.insert: insert into collect (goods_id, sku_id, user_id, time, goods_name, goods_img, spec, price) values (#{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{userId}, #{time}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImg}, #{spec}, #{price})
mapper.select: select * from collect where user_id = #{userId} and goods_id = #{goodsId} and spec = #{spec}

select c.*, g.name as goodsName, IFNULL(c.goods_img, g.img) as goodsImg, IFNULL(c.price, g.price) as goodsPrice, g.store as storeName from collect c left join goods g on c.goods_id = g.id
and c.user_id = #{userId} and c.goods_id = #{goodsId} and c.spec = #{spec}
and g.name like concat('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
order by c.id desc
